newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A1+ to KEPCO's $500 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A1+ to KEPCO's $500 mln notes.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Wednesday it had assigned its A1+ short-term rating to Korea Electric Power Corp's (KEPCO) $500 million worth of floating-rate notes due on August 7, 1998.
S&P also said it had assigned its AA- rating to KEPCO's $200 million 6.75 percent straight bond due on August 1, 2027.
At the same time, KEPCO's long-term rating outlook was revised to negative from stable, following the revision of South Korea's outlook to negative from stable, the rating agency said.
KEPCO's ratings are constrained by the rating of South Korea, which is AA-, S&P said.
It said the ongoing favourable regulatory treatment is expected to support KEPCO's strong financial profile despite heavy investment requirements.
